offers.title: Buy 1 Get 1 Free on Branded Eyewear
offers.description: Buy any branded frame or sunglasses and get the second pair absolutely FREE! Choose from over 1,500+ latest trendy designs.

offers.whatsappMessage: Hi Titan Eye+ Indiranagar, I would like to book a Free 20-Step Eye Test appointment.

offers.whatsappMessage: Hi Titan Eye+ Indiranagar, I need contact lenses (Bausch+Lomb/Alcon/Acuvue) with the free solution offer.

offers.title: Free Specs Repair, Alignment & Ultrasonic Cleaning
offers.description: Bring any spectacles (any brand) for deep ultrasonic cleaning, frame re-alignment, screw tightening, and silicone nose-pad replacement by master technician Murshid.

offers.whatsappMessage: Hi Titan Eye+ Indiranagar, I need frame repair/alignment service at your store.

offers.title: Progressive Lenses: Free Blue-Cut & Anti-Glare Upgrade

offers.whatsappMessage: Hi Titan Eye+ Indiranagar, I want to know more about Progressive Lenses with free blue-cut coating.
